Women Empowerment
develop  a  framework  in  compliance  with  the
National Policy on advancement and empowerment
of women to facilitate and ensure empowerment of
women (hereinafter referred to as the “framework”);
conduct  public  inquiries  in  relation  to  the
infringement or imminent infringement of women’s
rights;
institute actions in any competent Court on its own
motion in relation to the infringement or imminent
infringement of women’s rights;
take such steps as may be directed by a Superior
Court or by any other Court in respect of any matter
relating to women’s rights referred to by that Court;
request or call for any information or reports from
any  person  for  the  purpose  of  performing  any
function vested in the Commission under this Act
or any regulation made  thereunder;
inquire into, and investigate complaints with a view
to ensuring compliance with the provisions of the
Constitution  relating  to  women’s  rights  and  to
promoting respect for and observance of women’s
rights;
liaise and interact with state institutions, bodies or
authorities in order to foster common policies and
practices  and  to  promote  co-operation  in  relation
to the handling of complaints by the Commission;
open  regional  and  provincial  offices  of  the
Commission;
